The '''''Elfa''''' was the [[Calamarian minisub]] used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cilghal]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Zekk]], [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], and their friend [[Anja Gallandro]] during their mission in the ice caps of the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to destroy a hidden [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] stockpile of [[Andris/Legends|andris]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. It had two large grappling arms with pincer claws attached to the main body. The ''Elfa'' belonged to a [[Yarin/Legends|Yarin]] harbormaster at [[Crystal Reef]]. Its name translated in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] from the Yarin language as "fish-so-small-that-it-is-not-worth-catching".

However, they were attacked by a large tentacled [[Great Arctic Skra'akan]] after destroying the stockpile, and only managed to escape by piloting the ''Elfa'' through an iceberg labyrinth. The ice grounded together, nearly crushing the minisub, forcing the Jedi to wade into the freezing [[Water/Legends|water]] and then cut the ice with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. The ''Elfa'' made it back to [[Crystal Reef]] with its crew alive despite being badly damaged during the ordeal.
